text:
jess (eng-platform): quick question — a customer asked 'who changed routing policy X' and downloaded the audit export, but they said the banner that requested consent for the change isn't showing up in the export. can we surface UI/consent events in the NDJSON bundle?

mike (backend): do we currently record banner accepts as a first-class event? I thought we only log policy changes and the actor.

jess (eng-platform): right now we log ChangeEvent with actor, diff, and timestamp. banner events are ephemeral UI actions tied to sessions. not part of audit stream.

alana (product): from a product POV the ask is: compliance teams want the "context" — not just who flipped the switch but whether a user acknowledged a notice. important for investigations.

emily (design): +1 — the banner UI is distinct: we want to show "consent seen" vs "consent accepted". maybe include a minimal enum in export: consent_shown|consent_accepted|consent_dismissed.

sam (legal): we need to be careful about PII. if consent is user-specific, export must support redaction/pseudonymization. is that doable?

mike (backend): doable. proposal: emit ConsentEvent objects into the same export stream with fields: event_type, actor_id (pseudonymizable), target_policy_id, action, ts. Example NDJSON line: 

{
  "event_type": "consent",
  "actor_id": "user:anon_12345",
  "target": "routing:policy:X",
  "action": "consent_accepted",
  "ts": "2026-02-14T18:02:03Z"
}

jess (eng-platform): that matches what customers asked. two followups: 1) retention/quotas — these extra events will blow up export size; 2) rollout UX — can we gate this behind a feature flag for customers who opt-in?

mike (backend): for (1) we can add export-level sampling and offer a compact representation (consent enum + pointer to proof blob). For (2) yes — per-tenant flag. default off for now.

alana (product): per-tenant opt-in is ideal. also add a console toggle (with tooltip) explaining legal implications.

emily (design): tooltip copy suggestion: "Include user consent and banner interactions in audit exports. May include user identifiers; requires tenant-level opt-in and may increase export size."

sam (legal): also require an explicit entitlements check before enabling exports with consent events. audit exports with consent must only be downloadable by people with eDiscovery role.

jess (eng-platform): noted. telemetry question: if we add ConsentEvent type, do we also track which exports included consent events (for billing/usage and quota)? we need telemetry to understand cost impact.

mike (backend): yes we should emit export_manifest metrics: {export_id, tenant, event_types_included, compressed_size, raw_count}. that lets Optimize suggest batching/quantization.

sre-bot: deploy queued: add-consent-events-to-export v2 -> staging at 11:45 UTC :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jess (eng-platform): thanks. one more: how to present in console viewer? full NDJSON is fine for downloads but console preview should show a compact timeline that merges ChangeEvent + ConsentEvent into a single line per change. any strong opinions?

emily (design): compact timeline UI mock: 
- 2026-02-14 18:02 — Policy X updated by @mike (diff +3)
  • consent accepted by 2 users (link to details)

mike (backend): we can precompute a change_summary when rolling up export bundles. that summary can be stored in the export manifest and used by console.

alana (product): rollout plan: 1) beta tenants opt-in, 2) monitor export_manifest telemetry for size increase for 2 weeks, 3) enable wider rollout and add tenant quota warnings.

sam (legal): make sure the beta opt-in flow requires sign-off in ticket for customers in regulated sectors.

jess (eng-platform): i'll draft the API additions and the export schema change. quick sketch: 

Export Manifest additions: 
- event_types_included: ["change", "consent"]
- consent_event_sample_rate: "1.0" (string)
- precomputed_summaries: true|false

NDJSON schema additions: 
- consent_event: {event_type, actor_pseudonym, target, action, ts, meta: {ui_variant}}

mike (backend): sounds good. i'll prototype in a branch and wire the telemetry.

jess (eng-platform): perfect. tagging @alana @sam for product/legal signoff when i put the PR up. thanks all :thumbsup:
